paragraphs.text: The Myojin of Cryptic Dreams is the Myojin kami of inspiration on Kamigawa .

The Myojin of Cryptic Dreams embodies the force of inspiration. It has never shown itself fully in the mortal realm. Instead, it visits mortals in the dreams, where it shows itself only as a reflection on a mirrored surface and whispers to them, planting new ideas in their minds. Each reflection of the myojin is a unique mirror aspect of it. It has an infinite number of such mirror aspects, each representing a new idea that no one on the plane has ever thought of before. . It is not known how it is related to the Myojin of Seeing Winds which also represents an aspect of blue magic.
